signals.summary: A fresh cluster of rescue-to-recovery animal stories: abandoned pups looking unrecognizable weeks later, stray cats taken in, and long-shot dogs finding forever homes. The candid before/after arc is the exact heartwarming format the audience rewards.

signals.summary: The 'catio' — an enclosed outdoor cat space — keeps surfacing as a summer well-being trend, alongside studies backing supervised outdoor access. Renders beautifully as a still or short clip of a cat lounging in a sunlit enclosure.
signals.why_now: Three independent outlets carry the same wave: Brooklyn Paper's 'purr-fect catio' feature, CBC's build-your-own catio guide, and Psychology Today on outdoor access benefiting cats — a seasonal summer theme (Aug) that recurs and stays evergreen.
